scenes.title: Documentation Becomes Source
scenes.teachingPoint: The compiler turns structured documentation into inspectable video artifacts.

visual.metaphor: A pipeline from document AST to rendered video

narration.text: Documentation is now treated as source code. The compiler parses structure, analyzes meaning, plans the story, directs visuals, prepares assets, writes narration, and hands renderer-neutral animation intent to Remotion.
